name: Business Visa

requirement_groups.name: Investment in a South African business

requirements.blocker_text: Requires capital investment in a South African business, commonly cited at a floor of ZAR 5,000,000 (with a lower threshold sometimes applied for businesses in government-prioritised sectors), backed by a business plan and endorsement from the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (the dtic).
requirements.fix_path: Structure a qualifying investment meeting the applicable threshold and secure dtic endorsement of the business plan.

evidence_required.document: Proof of capital investment transferred into South Africa
Undertaking to employ a set proportion of South African citizens or permanent residents

sources.title: Employsome -- Work Permit South Africa 2026: 6 Visa Types & TES Fast-Track, describing the Business Visa category among South Africa's principal visa types

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of a dha.gov.za or dtic.gov.za page was achieved for this route in this research pass, and the ZAR 5,000,000 figure rests on a single source's general characterisation rather than a directly-confirmed current regulatory threshold -- flagged as a priority target for tier-1 verification given how central this figure is to the route's core test. STRUCTURAL NOTE: this route is distinct from za_permanent_residence's Section 27(f) financially-independent track, which is asset-holding-based (net worth) rather than active-business-investment-based -- the Business Visa requires the capital to be deployed into an operating South African enterprise with a job-creation commitment, not simply held. Given the general pattern of Department of Home Affairs processing backlogs documented across multiple routes in this build, and the White Paper reforms flagged on za_permanent_residence as pending as of 2026, this route's specific thresholds and processing timelines should be treated as more likely to change than most other figures in this dataset.
